title: The Cellar of the Undercroft
author: Juniper Okafor
blurb: Casper Pemberton, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
